Chapter 6668: Dream Of The Past

Chapter 6668: Dream Of The Past

“Show me what you can do outside of relying on this worm.” Li Qiye said, successfully striking a sore spot.

“I will show you my dao, Sacred Teacher!” Bao Pu shouted, displaying too much emotion for an immortal.

He naturally had more than just this worm. His dao was noble, created by the three immortals.

“Unfortunately, it is not an immortal dao.” Li Qiye said.

“Just you see.” He looked down on the world but Li Qiye looked down on him.

“Boom!” He erupted with a light originating from the start of time.

“Dao of the founder!” He roared, causing resonance all over Three Immortals.

This world seemed to be returning to its original state without any laws or dao. Early inhabitants couldn’t feel them.

It wasn’t until a founder appeared and taught everyone how to channel worldly essences and dao into their body.

“This is?” Everyone in Three Immortals found themselves returning to this initial period. Essences flowed into them without needing to cultivate.

“Bao Pu!” All beings saw an image of Bao Pu guiding followers who were ready to die for him.

“A dream to the past where I was the creator!” His light engulfed Three Immortals, awakening the previous dao system.

This was the path of the True Emperors and progenitors. Initially, those affected felt themselves being in charge of the world. In the next second, Bao Pu was the sole ruler.

“Witness my dao, Sacred Teacher! Bao Pu’s founder dao!” He shouted.

Everything started to melt together in Three Immortals. Cultivators outside became alarmed right away.

“This is a refinement! He wants to refine Three Immortals!” An overlord shouted.

These first dao were rooted in their world. However, Bao Pu controlled them to refine everything into his power. He had initially abandoned this founder dao for the worm one.

The latter turned him into an immortal so the founder dao was no longer useful. Today, he found Li Qiye’s comment insulting. Under his rage, he picked it up again.

The dao itself was not at the immortal level but what if he were to refine Three Immortals? Perhaps it would unleash a force strong enough to prove himself.

“This is terrible!” Three Immortals twisted and melted like ice cream under the sun.

“It’s breaking down!” Others became horrified since an immortal didn’t have much difficulty refining a world.

“Scram.” Li Qiye became visibly annoyed before unleashing a kick.

Bao Pu diverted his founder dao toward Li Qiye to stop the kick.

“Bam!” The dao was large enough to encompass Three Immortals but Li Qiye still crushed it and kicked Bao Pu.

“Crack!” The latter vomited blood; his immortal body couldn’t endure the direct strike as he was sent flying.
